ev.q: GYTS data indicate that nearly two of every 10 students reported currently using a tobacco product
This report presents estimates of self-reported cigarette and other tobacco-product use during 1999--2005
Nearly two in 10 students (17.3%) were currently using any form of tobacco

Any tobacco use was highest in the American and European regions (22.2% and 19.8%, respectively)
Boys were significantly more likely than girls to smoke cigarettes in the African, South-East Asian, and Western Pacific regions.
The survey uses a two-stage, cluster-sample design that produces representative samples
GYTS is a school-based survey that collects data from students aged 13--15 years

methods_quotes.q: Software for statistical analysis of correlated data was used to compute 95% confidence intervals.
Two-tailed t tests were used to establish significant differences.
Regional aggregations were calculated as means weighted by the population of the sampling frame.
